extraction: Primary publisher pages located through web search. Substantive search-index extracts were readable; several direct documentation opens returned a JS shell or timed out. No inaccessible full-page content was treated as read.

sources.title: PC status-bar API changes
sources.assessment: Huawei documents addToStatusBar, icon/menu updates and DesktopExtensionKit. This rebuts an OS-wide absence claim; it does not establish full Electron Tray parity.

sources.title: Core Speech Kit
sources.assessment: Huawei exposes text-to-speech as an SDK capability. Exact device, API, voice and plugin integration still need validation.

sources.title: Core Vision OCR FAQ
sources.assessment: Huawei describes an application-facing textRecognition.recognizeText API. This is an alternative capability family, not a reproduced substitute for the project OCR model.

sources.title: BLE connection and reconnection example
sources.assessment: Huawei documents BLE scanning, GATT connections and lifecycle handling. A missing Flutter plugin is not evidence of missing Bluetooth in the OS.

sources.title: Clipboard collaboration example
sources.assessment: Huawei documents the system pasteboard for local and cross-device copy/paste. Access rules and product support remain relevant.

sources.title: Printing application architecture
sources.assessment: Huawei describes an ArkTS/C++ printing application with phone, tablet and 2-in-1 HAPs. This rebuts an OS-wide printing impossibility claim.

sources.title: PC/tablet printing support
sources.assessment: Huawei documents printing on HarmonyOS 5.0+ PCs/tablets. It does not prove SciDAVis QPrinter integration.

sources.title: Agent-powered reminders
sources.assessment: Huawei documents reminders on PC/2in1 and other products, with controlled access, eligible app/scenario requirements, permission and notification authorization. Calendar Kit is a documented alternative.

sources.title: Stage process model
sources.assessment: Huawei documents 2in1 Ability/HAP process isolation. This is a lifecycle model, not unrestricted POSIX exec, PTY or permission to bundle executables.
